fixed.summary: The markdown profile is rendered by og from bun's JSON profile, so every function and caller is named at its file and line in the game's source; bun's own markdown named the game bundle (`game.native.js`, no line) for a sample without a position, about one run in five. The tables are the same sections (hot functions by self time, the call tree, each function's callers, callees and hot lines, the time by file); the call tree is now indented by depth.
